pairs.evidence: lib/foundry/verdictLog.ts:172 A verdict write that names no decider is logged as a human's: a PUT, a PATCH without `by`, and the commit's own auto-rejects (commitPlan.ts:80 mints `{verdict:"reject"}` with no `by`, then replaceVerdictMapHeld passes `undefined`). humanKeep then counts any keep without `by:"model"` as a vote toward `proven`, the state adoptionDraft/adoptInStore admit, so admission is still reachable through an unmarked default and not only through an authenticated human decision.

techniques.evidence: lib/foundry/verdictLog.ts:172 The `who` field defaults to human, so the append-only log records the commit's auto-rejects and unattributed writes as human verdicts that no one made.

lib/foundry/commitPlan.ts:37 Only an explicit `model` keep is kept out of the admitting count. An absent `by` (legacy or unattributed) counts as a human vote toward `proven`, and `proven` gates adoption into the Library (adopt.ts:229).
lib/foundry/verdictLog.ts:241 Who decided is read from the request body as a claim, not resolved from an authenticated principal, so the sender of a write chooses whether it counts as a human's.
lib/foundry/verdictLog.ts:202 A stale base is refused with a 409 that carries the current revision, never merged. A committed run refuses further writes (guarded/committed, store.ts:274).
lib/foundry/verdictLog.ts:132 A damaged verdicts.json is a loud 503 refusal, not read as an empty, undecided map.

pairs.evidence: packages/ui/src/board/boardGate.ts:110 Every revised write (patch, undo, pick, return) answers the kernel's stale-base conflict by re-reading and sending the same act again on the new revision, without the human seeing what moved. A same-key verdict another tab or agent made in between is overwritten, and because the kernel's planUndo (packages/kernel/src/decision/core.ts:125) takes back the newest act whoever made it, a stale undo can reverse someone else's decision.

techniques.evidence: packages/ui/src/board/boardGate.ts:110 The standard wants a verdict that lands on moved state refused loudly. Here the client turns the kernel's conflict into a silent re-base and resend.
packages/ui/src/board/boardGate.ts:136 A commit is only sent with the token of the preview that was shown. Commit, unlike the other writes, is not retried on conflict.

packages/ui/src/board/commit.ts:35 Undecided items block the commit instead of being recorded as rejects (the header contrasts this with v1's undecidedAs), so no verdict is minted that a human did not make.
packages/ui/src/board/commit.ts:1 The commit state machine is data (idle→previewing→shown→committing) and requires the consequence on screen before confirming.
packages/ui/src/board/cull.ts:16 The desk is complete by construction: an item whose row the presentation does not name is still drawn.
